1.zh: 耶稣基督的仆人保罗，奉召为使徒，特派传　神的福音。
1.en: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

1.zh: 这福音是　神从前借众先知在圣经上所应许的，
1.en: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

1.zh: 论到他儿子—我主耶稣基督。按肉体说，是从大卫后裔生的；
1.en: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

1.zh: 按圣善的灵说，因从死里复活，以大能显明是　神的儿子。
1.en: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

1.zh: 我们从他受了恩惠并使徒的职分，在万国之中叫人为他的名信服真道；
1.en: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

1.zh: 其中也有你们这蒙召属耶稣基督的人。
1.en: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

1.zh: 我写信给你们在罗马、为　神所爱、奉召作圣徒的众人。愿恩惠、平安从我们的父　神并主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 第一，我靠着耶稣基督，为你们众人感谢我的　神，因你们的信德传遍了天下。
1.en: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

1.zh: 我在他儿子福音上，用心灵所事奉的　神可以见证，我怎样不住地提到你们；
1.en: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

1.zh: 在祷告之间常常恳求，或者照　神的旨意，终能得平坦的道路往你们那里去。
1.en: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

1.zh: 因为我切切地想见你们，要把些属灵的恩赐分给你们，使你们可以坚固；
1.en: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

1.zh: 这样，我在你们中间，因你与我彼此的信心，就可以同得安慰。
1.en: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

1.zh: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我屡次定意往你们那里去，要在你们中间得些果子，如同在其余的外邦人中一样；只是到如今仍有阻隔。
1.en: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

1.zh: 无论是希腊人、化外人、聪明人、愚拙人，我都欠他们的债，
1.en: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

1.zh: 所以情愿尽我的力量，将福音也传给你们在罗马的人。
1.en: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

1.zh: 我不以福音为耻；这福音本是　神的大能，要救一切相信的，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
1.en: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

1.zh: 因为　神的义正在这福音上显明出来；这义是本于信，以至于信。如[经上]所记：「义人必因信得生。」
1.en: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

1.zh: 原来，　神的忿怒从天上显明在一切不虔不义的人身上，就是那些行不义阻挡真理的人。
1.en: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

1.zh: 神的事情，人所能知道的，原显明在人心里，因为　神已经给他们显明。
1.en: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

1.zh: 自从造天地以来，　神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得，叫人无可推诿。
1.en: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

1.zh: 因为，他们虽然知道　神，却不当作　神荣耀他，也不感谢他。他们的思念变为虚妄，无知的心就昏暗了。
1.en: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

1.zh: 自称为聪明，反成了愚拙，
1.en: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

1.zh: 将不能朽坏之　神的荣耀变为偶像，仿佛必朽坏的人和飞禽、走兽、昆虫的样式。
1.en: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

1.zh: 所以，　神任凭他们逞着心里的情欲行污秽的事，以致彼此玷辱自己的身体。
1.en: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

1.zh: 他们将　神的真实变为虚谎，去敬拜事奉受造之物，不敬奉那造物的主—主乃是可称颂的，直到永远。阿们！
1.en: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

1.zh: 因此，　神任凭他们放纵可羞耻的情欲。他们的女人把顺性的用处变为逆性的用处；
1.en: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

1.zh: 男人也是如此，弃了女人顺性的用处，欲火攻心，彼此贪恋，男和男行可羞耻的事，就在自己身上受这妄为当得的报应。
1.en: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

1.zh: 他们既然故意不认识　神，　神就任凭他们存邪僻的心，行那些不合理的事；
1.en: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

1.zh: 装满了各样不义、邪恶、贪婪、恶毒；满心是嫉妒、凶杀、争竞、诡诈、毒恨；
1.en: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

1.zh: 又是谗毁的、背后说人的、怨恨　神的、侮慢人的、狂傲的、自夸的、捏造恶事的、违背父母的、
1.en: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

1.zh: 无知的、背约的、无亲情的、不怜悯人的。
1.en: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

1.zh: 他们虽知道　神判定行这样事的人是当死的，然而他们不但自己去行，还喜欢别人去行。
1.en: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

2.zh: 你这论断人的，无论你是谁，也无可推诿。你在什么事上论断人，就在什么事上定自己的罪；因你这论断人的，自己所行却和别人一样。
2.en: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

2.zh: 我们知道这样行的人，　神必照真理审判他。
2.en: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

2.zh: 你这人哪，你论断行这样事的人，自己所行的却和别人一样，你以为能逃脱　神的审判吗？
2.en: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

2.zh: 还是你藐视他丰富的恩慈、宽容、忍耐，不晓得他的恩慈是领你悔改呢？
2.en: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

2.zh: 你竟任着你刚硬不悔改的心，为自己积蓄忿怒，以致　神震怒，显他公义审判的日子来到。
2.en: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

2.zh: 他必照各人的行为报应各人。
2.en: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

2.zh: 凡恒心行善、寻求荣耀、尊贵和不能朽坏[之福]的，就以永生报应他们；
2.en: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

2.zh: 惟有结党、不顺从真理、反顺从不义的，就以忿怒、恼恨报应他们；
2.en: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

2.zh: 将患难、困苦加给一切作恶的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人，
2.en: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

2.zh: 却将荣耀、尊贵、平安加给一切行善的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
2.en: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

2.zh: 因为　神不偏待人。
2.en: For there is no partiality with God.

2.zh: 凡没有律法犯了罪的，也必不按律法灭亡；凡在律法以下犯了罪的，也必按律法受审判。（
2.en: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

2.zh: 原来在　神面前，不是听律法的为义，乃是行律法的称义。
2.en: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

2.zh: 没有律法的外邦人若顺着本性行律法上的事，他们虽然没有律法，自己就是自己的律法。
2.en: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

2.zh: 这是显出律法的功用刻在他们心里，他们是非之心同作见证，并且他们的思念互相较量，或以为是，或以为非。）
2.en: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

2.zh: 就在　神借耶稣基督审判人隐秘事的日子，照着我的福音所言。
2.en: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

2.zh: 你称为犹太人，又倚靠律法，且指着　神夸口；
2.en: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

2.zh: 既从律法中受了教训，就晓得　神的旨意，也能分别是非；
2.en: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

2.zh: 又深信自己是给瞎子领路的，是黑暗中人的光，
2.en: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

2.zh: 是蠢笨人的师傅，是小孩子的先生，在律法上有知识和真理的模范。
2.en: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

2.zh: 你既是教导别人，还不教导自己吗？你讲说人不可偷窃，自己还偷窃吗？
2.en: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

2.zh: 你说人不可奸淫，自己还奸淫吗？你厌恶偶像，自己还偷窃庙中之物吗？
2.en: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

2.zh: 你指着律法夸口，自己倒犯律法、玷辱　神吗？
2.en: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

2.zh: 神的名在外邦人中，因你们受了亵渎，正如[经上]所记的。
2.en: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

2.zh: 你若是行律法的，割礼固然于你有益；若是犯律法的，你的割礼就算不得割礼。
2.en: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

2.zh: 所以那未受割礼的，若遵守律法的条例，他虽然未受割礼，岂不算是有割礼吗？
2.en: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

2.zh: 而且那本来未受割礼的，若能全守律法，岂不是要审判你这有仪文和割礼竟犯律法的人吗？
2.en: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

2.zh: 因为外面作犹太人的，不是[真]犹太人；外面肉身的割礼，也不是[真]割礼。
2.en: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

2.zh: 惟有里面作的，才是[真]犹太人；[真]割礼也是心里的，在乎灵，不在乎仪文。这人的称赞不是从人来的，乃是从　神来的。
2.en: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

3.zh: 这样说来，犹太人有什么长处？割礼有什么益处呢？
3.en: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

3.zh: 凡事大有好处：第一是　神的圣言交托他们。
3.en: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

3.zh: 即便有不信的，这有何妨呢？难道他们的不信就废掉　神的信吗？
3.en: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

3.zh: 断乎不能！不如说，　神是真实的，人都是虚谎的。如[经上]所记： 你责备人的时候，显为公义； 被人议论的时候，可以得胜。
3.en: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

3.zh: 我且照着人的常话说，我们的不义若显出　神的义来，我们可以怎么说呢？　神降怒，是他不义吗？
3.en: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

3.zh: 断乎不是！若是这样，　神怎能审判世界呢？
3.en: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

3.zh: 若　神的真实，因我的虚谎越发显出他的荣耀，为什么我还受审判，好像罪人呢？
3.en: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

3.zh: 为什么不说，我们可以作恶以成善呢？这是毁谤我们的人说我们有这话。这等人定罪是该当的。
3.en: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

3.zh: 这却怎么样呢？我们比他们强吗？决不是的！因我们已经证明：犹太人和希腊人都在罪恶之下。
3.en: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

3.zh: 就如[经上]所记： 没有义人，连一个也没有。
3.en: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

3.zh: 没有明白的； 没有寻求　神的；
3.en: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

3.zh: 都是偏离正路， 一同变为无用。 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
3.en: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

3.zh: 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓； 他们用舌头弄诡诈， 嘴唇里有虺蛇的毒气，
3.en: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

3.zh: 满口是咒骂苦毒。
3.en: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

3.zh: 杀人流血， 他们的脚飞跑，
3.en: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

3.zh: 所经过的路便行残害暴虐的事。
3.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

3.zh: 平安的路，他们未曾知道；
3.en: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

3.zh: 他们眼中不怕　神。
3.en: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

3.zh: 我们晓得律法上的话都是对律法以下之人说的，好塞住各人的口，叫普世的人都伏在　神审判之下。
3.en: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

3.zh: 所以凡有血气的，没有一个因行律法能在　神面前称义，因为律法本是叫人知罪。
3.en: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

3.zh: 但如今，　神的义在律法以外已经显明出来，有律法和先知为证：
3.en: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

3.zh: 就是　神的义，因信耶稣基督加给一切相信的人，并没有分别。
3.en: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

3.zh: 因为世人都犯了罪，亏缺了　神的荣耀；
3.en: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

3.zh: 如今却蒙　神的恩典，因基督耶稣的救赎，就白白地称义。
3.en: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

3.zh: 神设立耶稣作挽回祭，是凭着耶稣的血，借着人的信，要显明　神的义；因为他用忍耐的心宽容人先时所犯的罪，
3.en: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

3.zh: 好在今时显明他的义，使人知道他自己为义，也称信耶稣的人为义。
3.en: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

3.zh: 既是这样，哪里能夸口呢？没有可夸的了。用何法没有的呢？是用立功之法吗？不是，乃用信[主]之法。
3.en: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

3.zh: 所以我们看定了：人称义是因着信，不在乎遵行律法。
3.en: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

3.zh: 难道　神只作犹太人的　神吗？不也是作外邦人的　神吗？是的，也作外邦人的　神。
3.en: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

3.zh: 神既是一位，他就要因信称那受割礼的为义，也要因信称那未受割礼的为义。
3.en: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

3.zh: 这样，我们因信废了律法吗？断乎不是！更是坚固律法。
3.en: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

4.zh: 如此说来，我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕凭着肉体得了什么呢？
4.en: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

4.zh: 倘若亚伯拉罕是因行为称义，就有可夸的；只是在　神面前并无可夸。
4.en: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

4.zh: 经上说什么呢？说：「亚伯拉罕信　神，这就算为他的义。」
4.en: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

4.zh: 做工的得工价，不算恩典，乃是该得的；
4.en: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

4.zh: 惟有不做工的，只信称罪人为义的　神，他的信就算为义。
4.en: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

4.zh: 正如大卫称那在行为以外蒙　神算为义的人是有福的。
4.en: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

4.zh: [他]说： 得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的， 这人是有福的。
4.en: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

4.zh: 主不算为有罪的， 这人是有福的。
4.en: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

4.zh: 如此看来，这福是单加给那受割礼的人吗？不也是加给那未受割礼的人吗？因我们所说，亚伯拉罕的信，就算为他的义，
4.en: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

4.zh: 是怎么算的呢？是在他受割礼的时候呢？是在他未受割礼的时候呢？不是在受割礼的时候，乃是在未受割礼的时候。
4.en: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

4.zh: 并且他受了割礼的记号，作他未受割礼的时候因信称义的印证，叫他作一切未受割礼而信之人的父，使他们也算为义；
4.en: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

4.zh: 又作受割礼之人的父，就是那些不但受割礼，并且按我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕未受割礼而信之踪迹去行的人。
4.en: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

4.zh: 因为　[神]应许亚伯拉罕和他后裔，必得承受世界，不是因律法，乃是因信而得的义。
4.en: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

4.zh: 若是属乎律法的人才得为后嗣，信就归于虚空，应许也就废弃了。
4.en: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

4.zh: 因为律法是惹动忿怒的；哪里没有律法，那里就没有过犯。
4.en: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

4.zh: 所以[人得为后嗣]是本乎信，因此就属乎恩，叫应许定然归给一切后裔；不但归给那属乎律法的，也归给那效法亚伯拉罕之信的。
4.en: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

4.zh: 亚伯拉罕所信的，是那叫死人复活、使无变为有的　神，他在主面前作我们世人的父。如[经上]所记：「我已经立你作多国的父。」
4.en: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

4.zh: 他在无可指望的时候，因信仍有指望，就得以作多国的父，正如先前所说：「你的后裔将要如此。」
4.en: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

4.zh: 他将近百岁的时候，虽然想到自己的身体如同已死，撒拉的生育已经断绝，他的信心还是不软弱；
4.en: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

4.zh: 并且仰望　神的应许，总没有因不信心里起疑惑，反倒因信心里得坚固，将荣耀归给　神，
4.en: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

4.zh: 且满心相信　神所应许的必能做成。
4.en: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

4.zh: 所以，这就算为他的义。
4.en: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

4.zh: 「算为他义」的这句话不是单为他写的，
4.en: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

4.zh: 也是为我们将来得算为义之人写的，就是我们这信　神使我们的主耶稣从死里复活的人。
4.en: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

4.zh: 耶稣被交给人，是为我们的过犯；复活，是为叫我们称义。
4.en: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

5.zh: 我们既因信称义，就借着我们的主耶稣基督得与　神相和。
5.en: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

5.zh: 我们又借着他，因信得进入现在所站的这恩典中，并且欢欢喜喜盼望　神的荣耀。
5.en: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

5.zh: 不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，
5.en: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

5.zh: 忍耐生老练，老练生盼望；
5.en: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

5.zh: 盼望不至于羞耻，因为所赐给我们的圣灵将　神的爱浇灌在我们心里。
5.en: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

5.zh: 因我们还软弱的时候，基督就按所定的日期为罪人死。
5.en: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

5.zh: 为义人死，是少有的；为仁人死，或者有敢做的。
5.en: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

5.zh: 惟有基督在我们还作罪人的时候为我们死，　神的爱就在此向我们显明了。
5.en: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

5.zh: 现在我们既靠着他的血称义，就更要借着他免去　[神的]忿怒。
5.en: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

5.zh: 因为我们作仇敌的时候，且借着　神儿子的死，得与　神和好；既已和好，就更要因他的生得救了。
5.en: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

5.zh: 不但如此，我们既借着我主耶稣基督得与　神和好，也就借着他以　神为乐。
5.en: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

5.zh: 这就如罪是从一人入了世界，死又是从罪来的，于是死就临到众人，因为众人都犯了罪。
5.en: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

5.zh: 没有律法之先，罪已经在世上；但没有律法，罪也不算罪。
5.en: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

5.zh: 然而从亚当到摩西，死就作了王，连那些不与亚当犯一样罪过的，也在他的权下。亚当乃是那以后要来之人的预像。
5.en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

5.zh: 只是过犯不如恩赐，若因一人的过犯，众人都死了，何况　神的恩典，与那因耶稣基督一人恩典中的赏赐，岂不更加倍地临到众人吗？
5.en: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

5.zh: 因一人犯罪就定罪，也不如恩赐，原来审判是由一人而定罪，恩赐乃是由许多过犯而称义。
5.en: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

5.zh: 若因一人的过犯，死就因这一人作了王，何况那些受洪恩又蒙所赐之义的，岂不更要因耶稣基督一人在生命中作王吗？
5.en: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

5.zh: 如此说来，因一次的过犯，众人都被定罪；照样，因一次的义行，众人也就被称义得生命了。
5.en: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

5.zh: 因一人的悖逆，众人成为罪人；照样，因一人的顺从，众人也成为义了。
5.en: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

5.zh: 律法本是外添的，叫过犯显多；只是罪在哪里显多，恩典就更显多了。
5.en: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

5.zh: 就如罪作王叫人死；照样，恩典也借着义作王，叫人因我们的主耶稣基督得永生。
5.en: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

6.zh: 这样，怎么说呢？我们可以仍在罪中、叫恩典显多吗？
6.en: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

6.zh: 断乎不可！我们在罪上死了的人岂可仍在罪中活着呢？
6.en: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

6.zh: 岂不知我们这受洗归入基督耶稣的人是受洗归入他的死吗？
6.en: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

6.zh: 所以，我们借着洗礼归入死，和他一同埋葬，原是叫我们一举一动有新生的样式，像基督借着父的荣耀从死里复活一样。
6.en: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

6.zh: 我们若在他死的形状上与他联合，也要在他复活的形状上与他联合；
6.en: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

6.zh: 因为知道我们的旧人和他同钉十字架，使罪身灭绝，叫我们不再作罪的奴仆；
6.en: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

6.zh: 因为已死的人是脱离了罪。
6.en: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

6.zh: 我们若是与基督同死，就信必与他同活。
6.en: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

6.zh: 因为知道基督既从死里复活，就不再死，死也不再作他的主了。
6.en: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

6.zh: 他死是向罪死了，只有一次；他活是向　神活着。
6.en: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

6.zh: 这样，你们向罪也当看自己是死的；向　神在基督耶稣里，却当看自己是活的。
6.en: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

6.zh: 所以，不要容罪在你们必死的身上作王，使你们顺从身子的私欲。
6.en: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

6.zh: 也不要将你们的肢体献给罪作不义的器具；倒要像从死里复活的人，将自己献给　神，并将肢体作义的器具献给　神。
6.en: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

6.zh: 罪必不能作你们的主；因你们不在律法之下，乃在恩典之下。
6.en: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

6.zh: 这却怎么样呢？我们在恩典之下，不在律法之下，就可以犯罪吗？断乎不可！
6.en: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

6.zh: 岂不晓得你们献上自己作奴仆，顺从谁，就作谁的奴仆吗？或作罪的奴仆，以至于死；或作顺命的奴仆，以至成义。
6.en: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

6.zh: 感谢　神！因为你们从前虽然作罪的奴仆，现今却从心里顺服了所传给你们道理的模范。
6.en: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

6.zh: 你们既从罪里得了释放，就作了义的奴仆。
6.en: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

6.zh: 我因你们肉体的软弱，就照人的常话对你们说。你们从前怎样将肢体献给不洁不法作奴仆，以至于不法；现今也要照样将肢体献给义作奴仆，以至于成圣。
6.en: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

6.zh: 因为你们作罪之奴仆的时候，就不被义约束了。
6.en: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

6.zh: 你们现今所看为羞耻的事，当日有什么果子呢？那些事的结局就是死。
6.en: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

6.zh: 但现今，你们既从罪里得了释放，作了　神的奴仆，就有成圣的果子，那结局就是永生。
6.en: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

6.zh: 因为罪的工价乃是死；惟有　神的恩赐，在我们的主基督耶稣里，乃是永生。
6.en: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

7.zh: 弟兄们，我现在对明白律法的人说，你们岂不晓得律法管人是在活着的时候吗？
7.en: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

7.zh: 就如女人有了丈夫，丈夫还活着，就被律法约束；丈夫若死了，就脱离了丈夫的律法。
7.en: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

7.zh: 所以丈夫活着，她若归于别人，便叫淫妇；丈夫若死了，她就脱离了丈夫的律法，虽然归于别人，也不是淫妇。
7.en: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

7.zh: 我的弟兄们，这样说来，你们借着基督的身体，在律法上也是死了，叫你们归于别人，就是归于那从死里复活的，叫我们结果子给　神。
7.en: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

7.zh: 因为我们属肉体的时候，那因律法而生的恶欲就在我们肢体中发动，以致结成死亡的果子。
7.en: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

7.zh: 但我们既然在捆我们的律法上死了，现今就脱离了律法，叫我们服事[主]，要按着心灵的新样，不按着仪文的旧样。
7.en: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

7.zh: 这样，我们可说什么呢？律法是罪吗？断乎不是！只是非因律法，我就不知何为罪。非律法说「不可起贪心」，我就不知何为贪心。
7.en: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

7.zh: 然而，罪趁着机会，就借着诫命叫诸般的贪心在我里头发动；因为没有律法，罪是死的。
7.en: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

7.zh: 我以前没有律法是活着的；但是诫命来到，罪又活了，我就死了。
7.en: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

7.zh: 那本来叫人活的诫命，反倒叫我死；
7.en: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

7.zh: 因为罪趁着机会，就借着诫命引诱我，并且杀了我。
7.en: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

7.zh: 这样看来，律法是圣洁的，诫命也是圣洁、公义、良善的。
7.en: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

7.zh: 既然如此，那良善的是叫我死吗？断乎不是！[叫我死的乃是罪]。但罪借着那良善的叫我死，就显出真是罪，叫罪因着诫命更显出是恶极了。
7.en: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

7.zh: 我们原晓得律法是属乎灵的，但我是属乎肉体的，是已经卖给罪了。
7.en: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

7.zh: 因为我所做的，我自己不明白；我所愿意的，我并不做；我所恨恶的，我倒去做。
7.en: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

7.zh: 若我所做的，是我所不愿意的，我就应承律法是善的。
7.en: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

7.zh: 既是这样，就不是我做的，乃是住在我里头的罪做的。
7.en: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

7.zh: 我也知道，在我里头，就是我肉体之中，没有良善。因为，立志为善由得我，只是行出来由不得我。
7.en: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

7.zh: 故此，我所愿意的善，我反不做；我所不愿意的恶，我倒去做。
7.en: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

7.zh: 若我去做所不愿意做的，就不是我做的，乃是住在我里头的罪做的。
7.en: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

7.zh: 我觉得有个律，就是我愿意为善的时候，便有恶与我同在。
7.en: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

7.zh: 因为按着我里面的意思，我是喜欢　神的律；
7.en: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

7.zh: 但我觉得肢体中另有个律和我心中的律交战，把我掳去，叫我附从那肢体中犯罪的律。
7.en: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

7.zh: 我真是苦啊！谁能救我脱离这取死的身体呢？
7.en: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

7.zh: 感谢　神，靠着我们的主耶稣基督[就能脱离了]。这样看来，我以内心顺服　神的律，我肉体却顺服罪的律了。
7.en: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

8.zh: 如今，那些在基督耶稣里的就不定罪了。
8.en: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

8.zh: 因为赐生命[圣]灵的律，在基督耶稣里释放了我，使我脱离罪和死的律了。
8.en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

8.zh: 律法既因肉体软弱，有所不能行的，　神就差遣自己的儿子，成为罪身的形状，作了赎罪祭，在肉体中定了罪案，
8.en: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

8.zh: 使律法的义成就在我们这不随从肉体、只随从[圣]灵的人身上。
8.en: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

8.zh: 因为，随从肉体的人体贴肉体的事；随从[圣]灵的人体贴[圣]灵的事。
8.en: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

8.zh: 体贴肉体的，就是死；体贴[圣]灵的，乃是生命、平安。
8.en: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

8.zh: 原来体贴肉体的，就是与　神为仇；因为不服　神的律法，也是不能服，
8.en: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

8.zh: 而且属肉体的人不能得　神的喜欢。
8.en: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

8.zh: 如果　神的灵住在你们心里，你们就不属肉体，乃属[圣]灵了。人若没有基督的灵，就不是属基督的。
8.en: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

8.zh: 基督若在你们心里，身体就因罪而死，心灵却因义而活。
8.en: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

8.zh: 然而，叫耶稣从死里复活者的灵若住在你们心里，那叫基督耶稣从死里复活的，也必借着住在你们心里的[圣]灵，使你们必死的身体又活过来。
8.en: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

8.zh: 弟兄们，这样看来，我们并不是欠肉体的债去顺从肉体活着。
8.en: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

8.zh: 你们若顺从肉体活着，必要死；若靠着[圣]灵治死身体的恶行，必要活着。
8.en: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

8.zh: 因为凡被　神的灵引导的，都是　神的儿子。
8.en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

8.zh: 你们所受的，不是奴仆的心，仍旧害怕；所受的，乃是儿子的心，因此我们呼叫：「阿爸！父！」
8.en: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

8.zh: 圣灵与我们的心同证我们是　神的儿女；
8.en: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

8.zh: 既是儿女，便是后嗣，就是　神的后嗣，和基督同作后嗣。如果我们和他一同受苦，也必和他一同得荣耀。
8.en: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

8.zh: 我想，现在的苦楚若比起将来要显于我们的荣耀就不足介意了。
8.en: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

8.zh: 受造之物切望等候　神的众子显出来。
8.en: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

8.zh: 因为受造之物服在虚空之下，不是自己愿意，乃是因那叫他如此的。
8.en: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

8.zh: 但受造之物仍然指望脱离败坏的辖制，得享　神儿女自由的荣耀。
8.en: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

8.zh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息，劳苦，直到如今。
8.en: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

8.zh: 不但如此，就是我们这有[圣]灵初结果子的，也是自己心里叹息，等候得着儿子的名分，乃是我们的身体得赎。
8.en: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

8.zh: 我们得救是在乎盼望；只是所见的盼望不是盼望，谁还盼望他所见的呢？
8.en: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

8.zh: 但我们若盼望那所不见的，就必忍耐等候。
8.en: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

8.zh: 况且，我们的软弱有[圣]灵帮助；我们本不晓得当怎样祷告，只是[圣]灵亲自用说不出来的叹息替我们祷告。
8.en: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

8.zh: 鉴察人心的，晓得[圣]灵的意思，因为[圣]灵照着　神的[旨意]替圣徒祈求。
8.en: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

8.zh: 我们晓得万事都互相效力，叫爱　神的人得益处，就是按他旨意被召的人。
8.en: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

8.zh: 因为他预先所知道的人，就预先定下效法他儿子的模样，使他儿子在许多弟兄中作长子。
8.en: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

8.zh: 预先所定下的人又召他们来；所召来的人又称他们为义；所称为义的人又叫他们得荣耀。
8.en: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

8.zh: 既是这样，还有什么说的呢？　神若帮助我们，谁能敌挡我们呢？
8.en: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

8.zh: 神既不爱惜自己的儿子，为我们众人舍了，岂不也把万物和他一同白白地赐给我们吗？
8.en: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

8.zh: 谁能控告　神所拣选的人呢？有　神称他们为义了。
8.en: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

8.zh: 谁能定他们的罪呢？有基督耶稣已经死了，而且从死里复活，现今在　神的右边，也替我们祈求。
8.en: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

8.zh: 谁能使我们与基督的爱隔绝呢？难道是患难吗？是困苦吗？是逼迫吗？是饥饿吗？是赤身露体吗？是危险吗？是刀剑吗？
8.en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

8.zh: 如[经上]所记： 我们为你的缘故终日被杀； 人看我们如将宰的羊。
8.en: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

8.zh: 然而，靠着爱我们的[主]，在这一切的事上已经得胜有余了。
8.en: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

8.zh: 因为我深信无论是死，是生，是天使，是掌权的，是有能的，是现在的事，是将来的事，
8.en: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

8.zh: 是高处的，是低处的，是别的受造之物，都不能叫我们与　神的爱隔绝；这爱是在我们的主基督耶稣里的。
8.en: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

9.zh: 我在基督里说真话，并不谎言，有我良心被圣灵感动，给我作见证：
9.en: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

9.zh: 我是大有忧愁，心里时常伤痛；
9.en: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

9.zh: 为我弟兄，我骨肉之亲，就是自己被咒诅，与基督分离，我也愿意。
9.en: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

9.zh: 他们是以色列人；那儿子的名分、荣耀、诸约、律法、礼仪、应许都是他们的。
9.en: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

9.zh: 列祖就是他们的祖宗；按肉体说，基督也是从他们出来的。他是在万有之上，永远可称颂的　神。阿们！
9.en: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

9.zh: 这不是说　神的话落了空。因为从以色列生的不都是以色列人，
9.en: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

9.zh: 也不因为是亚伯拉罕的后裔就都作他的儿女；惟独「从以撒生的才要称为你的后裔。」
9.en: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

9.zh: 这就是说，肉身所生的儿女不是　神的儿女，惟独那应许的儿女才算是后裔。
9.en: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

9.zh: 因为所应许的话是这样说：「到[明年]这时候我要来，撒拉必生一个儿子。」
9.en: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

9.zh: 不但如此，还有利百加，既从一个人，就是从我们的祖宗以撒怀了孕，（
9.en: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

9.zh: [双子]还没有生下来，善恶还没有做出来，只因要显明　神拣选人的旨意，不在乎人的行为，乃在乎召人的[主]。）
9.en: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

9.zh: 神就对利百加说：「将来，大的要服事小的。」
9.en: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

9.zh: 正如[经上]所记：雅各是我所爱的；以扫是我所恶的。
9.en: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

9.zh: 这样，我们可说什么呢？难道　神有什么不公平吗？断乎没有！
9.en: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

9.zh: 因他对摩西说： 我要怜悯谁就怜悯谁， 要恩待谁就恩待谁。
9.en: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

9.zh: 据此看来，这不在乎那定意的，也不在乎那奔跑的，只在乎发怜悯的　神。
9.en: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

9.zh: 因为经上有话向法老说：「我将你兴起来，特要在你身上彰显我的权能，并要使我的名传遍天下。」
9.en: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

9.zh: 如此看来，　神要怜悯谁就怜悯谁，要叫谁刚硬就叫谁刚硬。
9.en: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

9.zh: 这样，你必对我说：「他为什么还指责人呢？有谁抗拒他的旨意呢？」
9.en: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

9.zh: 你这个人哪，你是谁，竟敢向　神强嘴呢？受造之物岂能对造他的说：「你为什么这样造我呢？」
9.en: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

9.zh: 窑匠难道没有权柄从一团泥里拿一块做成贵重的器皿，又拿一块做成卑贱的器皿吗？
9.en: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

9.zh: 倘若　神要显明他的忿怒，彰显他的权能，就多多忍耐宽容那可怒、预备遭毁灭的器皿，
9.en: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

9.zh: 又要将他丰盛的荣耀彰显在那蒙怜悯、早预备得荣耀的器皿上。
9.en: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

9.zh: 这[器皿]就是我们被　神所召的，不但是从犹太人中，也是从外邦人中。这有什么不可呢？
9.en: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

9.zh: 就像　神在何西阿书上说： 那本来不是我子民的， 我要称为「我的子民」； 本来不是蒙爱的， 我要称为「蒙爱的」。
9.en: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

9.zh: 从前在什么地方对他们说： 你们不是我的子民， 将来就在那里称他们为「永生　神的儿子」。
9.en: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

9.zh: 以赛亚指着以色列人喊着说：「以色列人虽多如海沙，得救的不过是剩下的余数；
9.en: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

9.zh: 因为主要在世上施行他的话，叫他的话都成全，速速地完结。」
9.en: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

9.zh: 又如以赛亚先前说过： 若不是万军之主给我们存留余种， 我们早已像所多玛、蛾摩拉的样子了。
9.en: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

9.zh: 这样，我们可说什么呢？那本来不追求义的外邦人反得了义，就是因信而得的义。
9.en: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

9.zh: 但以色列人追求律法的义，反得不着律法的义。
9.en: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

9.zh: 这是什么缘故呢？是因为他们不凭着信心求，只凭着行为求；他们正跌在那绊脚石上。
9.en: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

9.zh: 就如经上所记： 我在锡安放一块绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石； 信靠他的人必不至于羞愧。
9.en: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”

10.zh: 弟兄们，我心里所愿的，向　神所求的，是要以色列人得救。
10.en: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

10.zh: 我可以证明，他们向　神有热心，但不是按着真知识；
10.en: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

10.zh: 因为不知道　神的义，想要立自己的义，就不服　神的义了。
10.en: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

10.zh: 律法的总结就是基督，使凡信他的都得着义。
10.en: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

10.zh: 摩西写着说：「人若行那出于律法的义，就必因此活着。」
10.en: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

10.zh: 惟有出于信心的义如此说：「你不要心里说：谁要升到天上去呢？（就是要领下基督来；）
10.en: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);

10.zh: 谁要下到阴间去呢？（就是要领基督从死里上来。）」
10.en: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

10.zh: 他到底怎么说呢？他说： 这道离你不远， 正在你口里，在你心里— （就是我们所传信[主]的道。）
10.en: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:

10.zh: 你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信　神叫他从死里复活，就必得救。
10.en: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

10.zh: 因为，人心里相信就可以称义，口里承认就可以得救。
10.en: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

10.zh: 经上说：「凡信他的人必不至于羞愧。」
10.en: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

10.zh: 犹太人和希腊人并没有分别，因为众人同有一位主；他也厚待一切求告他的人。
10.en: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

10.zh: 因为「凡求告主名的就必得救」。
10.en: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

10.zh: 然而，人未曾信他，怎能求他呢？未曾听见他，怎能信他呢？没有传道的，怎能听见呢？
10.en: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

10.zh: 若没有奉差遣，怎能传道呢？如[经]上所记：「报福音、传喜信的人，他们的脚[踪]何等佳美！」
10.en: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

10.zh: 只是人没有都听从福音，因为以赛亚说：「主啊，我们所传的有谁信呢？」
10.en: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”

10.zh: 可见，信道是从听道来的，听道是从基督的话来的。
10.en: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

10.zh: 但我说，人没有听见吗？诚然听见了。 他们的声音传遍天下； 他们的言语传到地极。
10.en: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

10.zh: 我再说，以色列人不知道吗？先有摩西说： 我要用那不成子民的惹动你们的愤恨； 我要用那无知的民触动你们的怒气。
10.en: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”

10.zh: 又有以赛亚放胆说： 没有寻找我的，我叫他们遇见； 没有访问我的，我向他们显现。
10.en: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”

10.zh: 至于以色列人，他说：「我整天伸手招呼那悖逆顶嘴的百姓。」
10.en: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

11.zh: 我且说，　神弃绝了他的百姓吗？断乎没有！因为我也是以色列人，亚伯拉罕的后裔，属便雅悯支派的。
11.en: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

11.zh: 神并没有弃绝他预先所知道的百姓。你们岂不晓得经上论到以利亚是怎么说的呢？他在　神面前怎样控告以色列人说：
11.en: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

11.zh: 「主啊，他们杀了你的先知，拆了你的祭坛，只剩下我一个人；他们还要寻索我的命。」
11.en: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

11.zh: 神的回话是怎么说的呢？[他说]：「我为自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的。」
11.en: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

11.zh: 如今也是这样，照着拣选的恩典，还有所留的余数。
11.en: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

11.zh: 既是出于恩典，就不在乎行为；不然，恩典就不是恩典了。
11.en: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

11.zh: 这是怎么样呢？以色列人所求的，他们没有得着。惟有蒙拣选的人得着了；其余的就成了顽梗不化的。
11.en: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

11.zh: 如[经上]所记： 　神给他们昏迷的心， 眼睛不能看见， 耳朵不能听见， 直到今日。
11.en: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

11.zh: 大卫也说： 愿他们的筵席变为网罗，变为机槛， 变为绊脚石，作他们的报应。
11.en: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

11.zh: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见； 愿你时常弯下他们的腰。
11.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

11.zh: 我且说，他们失脚是要他们跌倒吗？断乎不是！反倒因他们的过失，救恩便临到外邦人，要激动他们发愤。
11.en: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

11.zh: 若他们的过失为天下的富足，他们的缺乏为外邦人的富足，何况他们的丰满呢？
11.en: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

11.zh: 我对你们外邦人说这话；因我是外邦人的使徒，所以敬重我的职分，
11.en: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

11.zh: 或者可以激动我骨肉之亲发愤，好救他们一些人。
11.en: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

11.zh: 若他们被丢弃，天下就得[与　神]和好，他们被收纳，岂不是死而复生吗？
11.en: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

11.zh: 所献的新面若是圣洁，全团也就圣洁了；树根若是圣洁，树枝也就圣洁了。
11.en: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

11.zh: 若有几根枝子被折下来，你这野橄榄得接在其中，一同得着橄榄根的肥汁，
11.en: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

11.zh: 你就不可向[旧]枝子夸口；若是夸口，[当知道]不是你托着根，乃是根托着你。
11.en: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

11.zh: 你若说，那枝子被折下来是特为叫我接上。
11.en: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

11.zh: 不错！他们因为不信，所以被折下来；你因为信，所以立得住；你不可自高，反要惧怕。
11.en: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

11.zh: 神既不爱惜原来的枝子，也必不爱惜你。
11.en: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

11.zh: 可见，　神的恩慈和严厉向那跌倒的人是严厉的，向你是有恩慈的，只要你长久在他的恩慈里；不然，你也要被砍下来。
11.en: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

11.zh: 而且他们若不是长久不信，仍要被接上，因为　神能够把他们从新接上。
11.en: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

11.zh: 你是从那天生的野橄榄上砍下来的，尚且逆着性得接在好橄榄上，何况这本树的枝子，要接在本树上呢！
11.en: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

11.zh: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道这奥秘（恐怕你们自以为聪明），就是以色列人有几分是硬心的，等到外邦人的数目添满了，
11.en: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

11.zh: 于是以色列全家都要得救。如[经上]所记： 必有一位救主从锡安出来， 要消除雅各家的一切罪恶；
11.en: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

11.zh: 又[说]：我除去他们罪的时候， 这就是我与他们所立的约。
11.en: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

11.zh: 就着福音说，他们为你们的缘故是仇敌；就着拣选说，他们为列祖的缘故是蒙爱的。
11.en: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

11.zh: 因为　神的恩赐和选召是没有后悔的。
11.en: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

11.zh: 你们从前不顺服　神，如今因他们的不顺服，你们倒蒙了怜恤。
11.en: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

11.zh: 这样，他们也是不顺服，叫他们因着施给你们的怜恤，现在也就蒙怜恤。
11.en: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

11.zh: 因为　神将众人都圈在不顺服之中，特意要怜恤众人。
11.en: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

11.zh: 深哉，　神丰富的智慧和知识！ 他的判断何其难测！ 他的踪迹何其难寻！
11.en: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

11.zh: 谁知道主的心？ 谁作过他的谋士呢？
11.en: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

11.zh: 谁是先给了他， 使他后来偿还呢？
11.en: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

11.zh: 因为万有都是本于他， 倚靠他，归于他。 愿荣耀归给他，直到永远。阿们！
11.en: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

12.zh: 所以，弟兄们，我以　神的慈悲劝你们，将身体献上，当作活祭，是圣洁的，是　神所喜悦的；你们如此事奉乃是理所当然的。
12.en: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

12.zh: 不要效法这个世界，只要心意更新而变化，叫你们察验何为　神的善良、纯全、可喜悦的旨意。
12.en: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

12.zh: 我凭着所赐我的恩对你们各人说：不要看自己过于所当看的；要照着　神所分给各人信心的大小，看得合乎中道。
12.en: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

12.zh: 正如我们一个身子上有好些肢体，肢体也不都是一样的用处。
12.en: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

12.zh: 我们这许多人，在基督里成为一身，互相联络作肢体，也是如此。
12.en: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

12.zh: 按我们所得的恩赐，各有不同。或说预言，就当照着信心的程度说[预言]；
12.en: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

12.zh: 或作执事，就当[专一]执事；或作教导的，就当[专一]教导；
12.en: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

12.zh: 或作劝化的，就当[专一]劝化；施舍的，就当诚实；治理的，就当殷勤；怜悯人的，就当甘心。
12.en: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

12.zh: 爱人不可虚假。恶，要厌恶；善，要亲近。
12.en: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

12.zh: 爱弟兄，要彼此亲热；恭敬人，要彼此推让。
12.en: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

12.zh: 殷勤，不可懒惰；要心里火热，常常服事主。
12.en: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

12.zh: 在指望中要喜乐；在患难中要忍耐；祷告要恒切。
12.en: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

12.zh: 圣徒缺乏，要帮补；客，要一味地款待。
12.en: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

12.zh: 逼迫你们的，要给他们祝福；只要祝福，不可咒诅。
12.en: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

12.zh: 与喜乐的人要同乐；与哀哭的人要同哭。
12.en: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

12.zh: 要彼此同心；不要志气高大，倒要俯就卑微的人。不要自以为聪明。
12.en: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

12.zh: 不要以恶报恶；众人以为美的事要留心去做。
12.en: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

12.zh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。
12.en: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

12.zh: 亲爱的弟兄，不要自己伸冤，宁可让步，听凭主怒；因为[经上]记着：「主说：『伸冤在我，我必报应。』」
12.en: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

12.zh: 所以，「你的仇敌若饿了，就给他吃，若渴了，就给他喝；因为你这样行就是把炭火堆在他的头上。」
12.en: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

12.zh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
12.en: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

13.zh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于　神的。凡掌权的都是　神所命的。
13.en: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

13.zh: 所以，抗拒掌权的就是抗拒　神的命；抗拒的必自取刑罚。
13.en: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

13.zh: 作官的原不是叫行善的惧怕，乃是叫作恶的惧怕。你愿意不惧怕掌权的吗？你只要行善，就可得他的称赞；
13.en: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

13.zh: 因为他是　神的用人，是与你有益的。你若作恶，却当惧怕，因为他不是空空地佩剑；他是　神的用人，是伸冤的，刑罚那作恶的。
13.en: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

13.zh: 所以，你们必须顺服，不但是因为刑罚，也是因为良心。
13.en: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

13.zh: 你们纳粮，也为这个缘故；因他们是　神的差役，常常特管这事。
13.en: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

13.zh: 凡人所当得的，就给他。当得粮的，给他纳粮；当得税的，给他上税；当惧怕的，惧怕他；当恭敬的，恭敬他。
13.en: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

13.zh: 凡事都不可亏欠人，惟有彼此相爱要常以为亏欠，因为爱人的就完全了律法。
13.en: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

13.zh: 像那不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可贪婪，或有别的诫命，都包在爱人如己这一句话之内了。
13.en: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

13.zh: 爱是不加害与人的，所以爱就完全了律法。
13.en: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

13.zh: 再者，你们晓得，现今就是该趁早睡醒的时候；因为我们得救，现今比[初]信的时候更近了。
13.en: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

13.zh: 黑夜已深，白昼将近。我们就当脱去暗昧的行为，带上光明的兵器。
13.en: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

13.zh: 行事为人要端正，好像行在白昼。不可荒宴醉酒；不可好色邪荡；不可争竞嫉妒。
13.en: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

13.zh: 总要披戴主耶稣基督，不要为肉体安排，去[放纵]私欲。
13.en: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

14.zh: 信心软弱的，你们要接纳，但不要辩论所疑惑的事。
14.en: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

14.zh: 有人信百物都可吃；但那软弱的，只吃蔬菜。
14.en: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

14.zh: 吃的人不可轻看不吃的人；不吃的人不可论断吃的人；因为　神已经收纳他了。
14.en: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

14.zh: 你是谁，竟论断别人的仆人呢？他或站住或跌倒，自有他的主人在；而且他也必要站住，因为主能使他站住。
14.en: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

14.zh: 有人看这日比那日强；有人看日日都是一样。只是各人心里要意见坚定。
14.en: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

14.zh: 守日的人是为主守的。吃的人是为主吃的，因他感谢　神；不吃的人是为主不吃的，也感谢　神。
14.en: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

14.zh: 我们没有一个人为自己活，也没有一个人为自己死。
14.en: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

14.zh: 我们若活着，是为主而活；若死了，是为主而死。所以，我们或活或死总是主的人。
14.en: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

14.zh: 因此，基督死了，又活了，为要作死人并活人的主。
14.en: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

14.zh: 你这个人，为什么论断弟兄呢？又为什么轻看弟兄呢？因我们都要站在　神的台前。
14.en: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

14.zh: [经上]写着： 主说：我凭着我的永生起誓： 万膝必向我跪拜； 万口必向我承认。
14.en: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

14.zh: 这样看来，我们各人必要将自己的事在　神面前说明。
14.en: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

14.zh: 所以，我们不可再彼此论断，宁可定意谁也不给弟兄放下绊脚跌人之物。
14.en: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

14.zh: 我凭着主耶稣确知深信，凡物本来没有不洁净的；惟独人以为不洁净的，在他就不洁净了。
14.en: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

14.zh: 你若因食物叫弟兄忧愁，就不是按着爱人的道理行。基督已经替他死，你不可因你的食物叫他败坏。
14.en: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

14.zh: 不可叫你的善被人毁谤；
14.en: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

14.zh: 因为　神的国不在乎吃喝，只在乎公义、和平，并圣灵中的喜乐。
14.en: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

14.zh: 在这几样上服事基督的，就为　神所喜悦，又为人所称许。
14.en: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

14.zh: 所以，我们务要追求和睦的事与彼此建立[德行]的事。
14.en: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

14.zh: 不可因食物毁坏　神的工程。凡物固然洁净，但有人因食物叫人跌倒，就是他的罪了。
14.en: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

14.zh: 无论是吃肉是喝酒，是什么别的事，叫弟兄跌倒，一概不做才好。
14.en: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

14.zh: 你有信心，就当在　神面前守着。人在自己以为可行的事上能不自责，就有福了。
14.en: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

14.zh: 若有疑心而吃的，就必有罪，因为他吃不是出于信心。凡不出于信心的都是罪。
14.en: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,
but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;
to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.

15.zh: 我们坚固的人应该担代不坚固人的软弱，不求自己的喜悦。
15.en: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

15.zh: 我们各人务要叫邻舍喜悦，使他得益处，建立[德行]。
15.en: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

15.zh: 因为基督也不求自己的喜悦，如[经上]所记：「辱骂你人的辱骂都落在我身上。」
15.en: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

15.zh: 从前所写的[圣经]都是为教训我们写的，叫我们因圣经所生的忍耐和安慰可以得着盼望。
15.en: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

15.zh: 但愿赐忍耐安慰的　神叫你们彼此同心，效法基督耶稣，
15.en: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

15.zh: 一心一口荣耀　神—我们主耶稣基督的父！
15.en: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

15.zh: 所以，你们要彼此接纳，如同基督接纳你们一样，使荣耀归与　神。
15.en: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

15.zh: 我说，基督是为　神真理作了受割礼人的执事，要证实所应许列祖的话，
15.en: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

15.zh: 并叫外邦人因他的怜悯荣耀　神。如[经上]所记： 因此，我要在外邦中称赞你， 歌颂你的名；
15.en: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”

15.zh: 又说： 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢乐；
15.en: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

15.zh: 又说： 外邦啊，你们当赞美主！ 万民哪，你们都当颂赞他！
15.en: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

15.zh: 又有以赛亚说： 将来有耶西的根， 就是那兴起来要治理外邦的； 外邦人要仰望他。
15.en: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

15.zh: 但愿使人有盼望的　神，因信将诸般的喜乐、平安充满你们的心，使你们借着圣灵的能力大有盼望！
15.en: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

15.zh: 弟兄们，我自己也深信你们是满有良善，充足了诸般的知识，也能彼此劝戒。
15.en: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

15.zh: 但我稍微放胆写信给你们，是要提醒你们的记性，特因　神所给我的恩典，
15.en: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

15.zh: 使我为外邦人作基督耶稣的仆役，作　神福音的祭司，叫所献上的外邦人，因着圣灵成为圣洁，可蒙悦纳。
15.en: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

15.zh: 所以论到　神的事，我在基督耶稣里有可夸的。
15.en: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

15.zh: 除了基督借我做的那些事，我什么都不敢提，只提他借我言语作为，用神迹奇事的能力，并圣灵的能力，使外邦人顺服；
15.en: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

15.zh: 甚至我从耶路撒冷，直转到以利哩古，到处传了基督的福音。
15.en: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

15.zh: 我立了志向，不在基督的名被称过的地方传福音，免得建造在别人的根基上。
15.en: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

15.zh: 就如[经上]所记： 未曾闻知他信息的，将要看见； 未曾听过的，将要明白。
15.en: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

15.zh: 我因多次被拦阻，总不得到你们那里去。
15.en: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

15.zh: 但如今，在这里再没有[可传的]地方，而且这好几年，我切心想望到西班牙去的时候，可以到你们那里，
15.en: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

15.zh: 盼望从你们那里经过，得见你们，先与你们彼此交往，心里稍微满足，然后蒙你们送行。
15.en: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

15.zh: 但现在，我往耶路撒冷去供给圣徒。
15.en: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

15.zh: 因为马其顿和亚该亚人乐意凑出捐项给耶路撒冷圣徒中的穷人。
15.en: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

15.zh: 这固然是他们乐意的，其实也算是所欠的债；因外邦人既然在他们属灵的好处上有分，就当把养身之物供给他们。
15.en: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

15.zh: 等我办完了这事，把这善果向他们交付明白，我就要路过你们那里，往西班牙去。
15.en: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

15.zh: 我也晓得，去的时候必带着基督丰盛的恩典而去。
15.en: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

15.zh: 弟兄们，我借着我们主耶稣基督，又借着[圣]灵的爱，劝你们与我一同竭力，为我祈求　神，
15.en: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

15.zh: 叫我脱离在犹太不顺从的人，也叫我为耶路撒冷所办的捐项可蒙圣徒悦纳，
15.en: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

15.zh: 并叫我顺着　神的旨意，欢欢喜喜地到你们那里，与你们同得安息。
15.en: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

15.zh: 愿赐平安的　神常和你们众人同在。阿们！
15.en: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

16.zh: 我对你们举荐我们的姊妹非比；她是坚革哩教会中的女执事。
16.en: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

16.zh: 请你们为主接待她，合乎圣徒的体统。她在何事上要你们帮助，你们就帮助她；因她素来帮助许多人，也帮助了我。
16.en: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

16.zh: 问百基拉和亚居拉安。他们在基督耶稣里与我同工，
16.en: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

16.zh: 也为我的命将自己的颈项置之度外。不但我感谢他们，就是外邦的众教会也感谢他们。
16.en: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

16.zh: 又问在他们家中的教会安。问我所亲爱的以拜尼土安；他在亚细亚是归基督初结的果子。
16.en: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

16.zh: 又问马利亚安；她为你们多受劳苦。
16.en: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

16.zh: 又问我亲属与我一同坐监的安多尼古和犹尼亚安；他们在使徒中是有名望的，也是比我先在基督里。
16.en: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

16.zh: 又问我在主里面所亲爱的暗伯利安。
16.en: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

16.zh: 又问在基督里与我们同工的耳巴奴，并我所亲爱的士大古安。
16.en: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

16.zh: 又问在基督里经过试验的亚比利安。问亚利多布家里的人安。
16.en: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

16.zh: 又问我亲属希罗天安。问拿其数家在主里的人安。
16.en: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

16.zh: 又问为主劳苦的土非拿氏和土富撒氏安。问可亲爱为主多受劳苦的彼息氏安。
16.en: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

16.zh: 又问在主蒙拣选的鲁孚和他母亲安；他的母亲就是我的母亲。
16.en: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

16.zh: 又问亚逊其土、弗勒干、黑米、八罗巴、黑马，并与他们在一处的弟兄们安。
16.en: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

16.zh: 又问非罗罗古和犹利亚，尼利亚和他姊妹，同阿林巴并与他们在一处的众圣徒安。
16.en: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

16.zh: 你们亲嘴问安，彼此务要圣洁。基督的众教会都问你们安。
16.en: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

16.zh: 弟兄们，那些离间你们、叫你们跌倒、背乎所学之道的人，我劝你们要留意躲避他们。
16.en: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

16.zh: 因为这样的人不服事我们的主基督，只服事自己的肚腹，用花言巧语诱惑那些老实人的心。
16.en: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

16.zh: 你们的顺服已经传于众人，所以我为你们欢喜；但我愿意你们在善上聪明，在恶上愚拙。
16.en: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

16.zh: 赐平安的　神快要将撒但践踏在你们脚下。愿我主耶稣基督的恩常和你们同在！
16.en: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

16.zh: 与我同工的提摩太，和我的亲属路求、耶孙、所西巴德，问你们安。
16.en: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

16.zh: 我这代笔写信的德提，在主里面问你们安。
16.en: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

16.zh: 那接待我、也接待全教会的该犹问你们安。
16.en: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

16.zh: 城内管银库的以拉都和兄弟括土问你们安。
16.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

16.zh: 惟有　神能照我所传的福音和所讲的耶稣基督，并照永古隐藏不言的奥秘，坚固你们的心。
这奥秘如今显明出来，而且按着永生　神的命，借众先知的书指示万国的民，使他们信服真道。
愿荣耀，因耶稣基督，归与独一全智的　神，直到永远。阿们！
